Title: The effect of two different methods used during peripheral venous blood collection on pain reduction in neonates
Author: Emine Efe; Sevim Savafler
Comment: Table 2 values were extracted because extraction was restricted to the paper’s Results material; the Summary gives slightly more precise values. The reported F=47.31 and p=0.000 are three-group omnibus results and were not assigned to the direct breastfeeding-versus-control comparison. No unit conversion was needed. The control condition included maternal verbal soothing, post-injection cuddling, and an optional pacifier after injection, and therefore was routine care rather than a literally comfort-free condition. Allocation was based on mothers’ wishes, not randomization.
